title_candidates: When You Make Eye Contact In Public #shorts
Where To Look When Someone Walks Past #shorts

originality_audit.unique_intellectual_angle: Deconstructs the universal 20-meter approaching corridor anxiety into an evolutionary gaze problem. Replaces fake-texting coping mechanisms with the 3-step boundary nod, disarming the social tension effortlessly.

narrative_arc.hook: You’re walking down a walkway, and see someone heading straight toward you from twenty meters away. Instantly, your brain panics: where do you actually look?
narrative_arc.social_trap: Staring makes you look crazy; looking at the ground makes you look terrified. Most people fake-text on an empty home screen.
narrative_arc.mechanism: Pretending not to see someone signals obvious insecurity that everyone can detect.
narrative_arc.solution: Eyes relaxed on the horizon. At 3 steps away: calm eye contact, subtle upward nod, keep moving.
